overview_description.description:
Zid is an e-commerce in a box - solution that any retailer can use to start their eRetail. Zid helps them to build their own eStores (with their own name and identity) and integrates them with the supply chain players to enable them to manage and with ease. The company aims to enable the retail sector to enter the world of electronic retail in an easy and professional.

Zid was founded in 2017 and based in Riyadh, Ar Riyad, Saudi Arabia.

product.name: Zid E-commerce Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that enables retailers to create and manage online stores with integrated payment, shipping, and sales analytics features.

product.name: Zid Pay
product.description: A payment collection service integrated into the Zid platform to facilitate simple and secure online payment processing.

product.name: Zid Ship
product.description: A shipping service integrated with Zid that manages logistics and delivery for online orders within Gulf countries.

product.name: Sales Analytics and Reporting
product.description: Tools within Zid platform that provide merchants with insights into sales performance, customer behavior, and order data.

product.name: Discounts and Promo Codes Management
product.description: A feature in Zid platform that allows merchants to create and manage discounts and promotional codes for their online stores.

product.name: App Development and Integration Services
product.description: Services provided by Zid partners to develop and integrate custom applications and features into Zid stores.
